name: G N A Axles Limited
summary: G N A Axles Limited manufactures and sells automotive transmission components for the four-wheeler industry in North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The company offers rear axle shafts, spindles, and drive shafts. Its products are used in commercial vehicles, passenger vehicles, and off-highway vehicles. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Hoshiarpur, India.
